title: Emerald Compass
description:
The Emerald Compass is a compass that points to a specific player. You can change the target player by combining the compass with an ID Card in a crafting table. The ID Card must be bound to a player and is not used up by this.

The target position is updated once per second while the compass is anywhere in an inventory. It uses the target's X and Z coordinates only, so it also points to those coordinates if the player is in another dimension. If the target player is offline, the needle wobbles randomly.
